Name: Seasonal Eeveelutions (CP)
Author: wrennybirdy
Description:
A reskin of the cat to be Sylveon in spring, Leafeon in summer, Flareon in fall, and Glaceon in winter. 
[url=http://www.deviantart.com/shinywolf/art/Sylveon-PMD-Style-610001942]Sprites for Sylveon[/url] are originally by Shinywolf on DeviantArt, I used and edited them to fit the sprites I needed with their permission. All other sprites are from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon. Edited sprite sheets for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1673]Leafeon[/url] are by ImXTooNinjaxX and the edited sprite sheets for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1788]Glaceon[/url] are by Halfwheat.

Please let me know if there are any bugs. I'll try to fix them, but may not be able to because I'm not that experienced with modding.
I noticed that sometimes when you leave your house in the morning, your pet is not there, but it reappears when you reenter and exit the house again. I'm not sure how to fix that. If you have an idea of what the problem is, please tell me!

I also made a [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3792]Seasonal Leafeon.[/url]

Future plans: 
Seasonal Bulbasaur
Seasonal Deerling
Seasonal Eevee? With flower crowns? Maybe idk
Feel free to suggest more!
